champion.tips: MALPHITE TIPS AND TRICKS Use your Q as often as possible (while playing around Arcane Comet) to harass the enemy. Avoid running out of mana trying to poke though. If you’re building full AP Malphite Support, try to harass the enemy as much as possible before committing your Ultimate R to kill them. In team fights, you can either look for a multi-person knockup with your Ultimate R , or try to isolate a target that’s overextended and too far forward.
champion.builds: THE BEST MALPHITE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Malphite Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Cheap Shot and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Malignance. For your last 3 items, you should build Stormsurge, Shadowflame and finish with Rabadon's Deathcap. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 45.0% winrate over 1 725 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Dark Harvest as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Sixth Sense and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Malignance as a third item. You want to finish the build with Stormsurge, Shadowflame and Rabadon's Deathcap. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 45.0% win rate across 111 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Malphite Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Sixth Sense and Ultimate Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Malignance as third item. The last 3 options are Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap and Vigilant Wardstone. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 44.9% win rate over 107 matches played. Situational Malphite Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Malphite build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Malphite runes page.
